The '''jubba''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It produced<ref name="TCSWE" /> [[Jubba nut/Legends|jubba nuts]],<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> small [[Nut/Legends|nuts]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> that were the size of a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrg's]] [[Brain/Legends|brain]]<ref name="Wildlife" /> and considered [[Foodstuff/Legends|delicacies]] by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> which was also native to Endor.<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Behind the scenes==
The jubba was mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCSWE" />
